description:
Configure the XML Sitemap settings and generate the sitemap file. 

1. Navigate to 'Stores > Configuration > Catalog > XML Sitemap'.
2. Set 'Categories' Frequency to 'Daily' and Priority to '0.8'.
3. Set 'Products' Frequency to 'Daily' and Priority to '1.0'.
4. Set 'CMS Pages' Frequency to 'Weekly' and Priority to '0.5'.
5. Save the configuration.
6. Navigate to 'Marketing > SEO & Search > Site Map'.
7. Add a new Site Map with Filename 'sitemap.xml' and Path '/'.
8. Save and Generate the sitemap.

If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
